card.name: Linking words in resuscitation and breathing text
card.fires_on: Small linking words (he, is, or) right after a breathing, heartbeat or cardiac arrest phrase in emergency resuscitation text, where a word like breathing or pulse could come next.

modes.label: After cardiac arrest
modes.description: The word 'or' right after 'Cardiac arrest' in overdose supportive-care instructions.
modes.example: Cardiac arrest<< or>> arrhythmias will require advanced life support

modes.label: After breathing
modes.description: A verb right after 'breathing' in intensive care instructions.
modes.example: If breathing<< is>> significantly impaired, maintenance of an adequate air

modes.label: After CPR story
modes.description: A pronoun right after CPR is performed on a rescued person.
modes.example: But within seconds of having CPR performed on him,<< he>> sputtered water and regained consciousness.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words about breathing, pulse and heartbeat, and away from unrelated name pieces.
card.plain: It fires on small connecting words in resuscitation text, just before words about breathing or heartbeat.
